sourceHeader.time: 1 Reaction, which you take when a creature would cast a Jutsu with the M component.

system.description:
As a reaction to a creature casting a jutsu with the Mobility (M) component, you manipulate their blood to coagulate and spike, restricting their blood flow. The affected creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature’s movement is interrupted being reduced to 0 until the end of their next turn, causing their jutsu to fail and chakra to be wasted. The creature also takes 6d8 necrotic damage.

Blood Detonation. Some of the creatures veins and arteries rupture, causing them to gain 3 ranks of Bleed on a failure.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d8.
